build_data2vec_multi_model: build a Data2VecMultiModel instance using build_model with a Data2VecMultiConfig and task
extract_features_data2vec: extract features from audio, image, or text input using the extract_features method
forward_data2vec_multi: run the forward pass on source data with masking for self-supervised pretraining
configure_data2vec_modalities: configure audio, image, and text modality settings via D2vModalitiesConfig dataclass
remove_pretraining_modules: remove EMA teacher and pretraining modules from Data2VecMultiModel for downstream fine-tuning
